counterfactual_missing_items: no evidence of necrosis or hemorrhage typical of GIST
no spindle cells or c-KIT positivity mentioned
decisive_items: biopsy results were consistent with adipose tissue
a 6 cm mass arising from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum
response.rationale: R1 is supported by direct raw evidence of fat attenuation and adipose tissue on biopsy, which is pathognomonic for lipoma. R2 only cites the mass and muscularis propria origin, which is nonspecific and contradicted by the fat content. The imaging and biopsy findings decisively favor gastric lipoma over GIST.

rejected.why: Lacks raw support for fat content; muscularis propria origin alone is insufficient and GIST would not show predominantly fat attenuation or adipose tissue on biopsy.
